info.name: FinPlan API
info.description: FinPlan REST API (labs 1–2). Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (keep "Save cookies" on). Requires a freshly seeded database: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed. Every request uses the Bearer token in {{accessToken}} (Jonas) unless it overrides the auth.

item.name: 0. Authentication (register, login, refresh)
item.description: Guest endpoints. Logs in the three seeded users and stores their access tokens. The refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie kept by the Postman cookie jar.

exec: pm.test("New account is a member even if role=admin is sent", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.role).to.eql("member"));

item.name: 422 – register with an existing email and weak password

exec: pm.test("Token contains role admin and user ID", () => { pm.expect(claims.role).to.eql("admin"); pm.expect(claims.sub).to.eql(String(pm.response.json().data.id)); });

item.name: Login – Jonas (member, used by the rest of the collection)

exec: pm.test("Access token is short-lived (15 min)", () => pm.expect(claims.exp - claims.iat).to.eql(900));
pm.test("Message explains why", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("The token is invalid."));
pm.test("Location header points to the new category", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.match(/\/categories\/\d+$/));
pm.test("Only expense categories are returned", () => body.data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.type).to.eql("expense")));
pm.test("Has pagination meta and links", () => { pm.expect(body.meta.per_page).to.eql(5); pm.expect(body.links).to.have.property("next"); });
pm.test("Has spent / remaining", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property("spent"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("remaining"); });
pm.test("Links back to parent budget", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data._links.budget.href).to.include("/budgets/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("budgetId")));
pm.test("Has user, summary, budgets and recent transactions", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.keys("month", "user", "summary", "budgets", "recent_transactions"); });
pm.test("All amounts within range", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.amount).to.be.within(50, 80)));

item.name: 404 – budget exists but not in this category (scoping)
4. Authorization by role and owner (403)
item.description: Jonas owns categories 1–7, Ona owns 8–11. Members may only access their own data; the admin may view and delete anyone's data but not edit it.

item.name: 403 – Ona adds a budget to Jonas's category

exec: pm.test("All owned by Jonas", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.owner.id).to.eql(2)));
pm.test("No update link for the admin", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data[0]._links).to.not.have.property("update"));

item.name: 5. Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
item.description: Uses the member registered in folder 0. The TOTP code is computed in the pre-request script from the secret, exactly like an authenticator app.

exec: // TOTP (RFC 6238) computed from the secret, like an authenticator app does.
for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) hex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");

item.name: Login – password step returns a 2FA challenge
401 – the 2FA challenge token is not an access token
